findingDetails.evidence: Row added in 0837fcd5a2; 191ce39bad later updated lib/continuity/README.md:28 to name lib/spec/packet-purpose.ts as the source of packet_purpose on every continuity write.
findingDetails.userImpact: Documentation-only; readers get an incomplete consumer map.
findingDetails.scopeProof: git show documentation diff over the ten commits: the index row appears only in 0837fcd5a2 and is untouched by the continuity commit 191ce39bad.
findingDetails.recommendation: Name both readers in the row: the post-compaction brief and the continuity envelope.
